TableField.description: Field represents a single field in a table

calc_formula.description: Sum, Count, Lookup, Exist, Average, Min, Max

caption.description: The field's English caption, for people reading the file (the captions shown come from the translations).

caption_class.description: CaptionClass (classic CaptionClass): the caption expression the field's caption is resolved with, "<area>,<arguments>" — "1,<kind>,<n>" a dimension field (the company's name for dimension n), "3,<text>" a free text (i18n/captionclass.go)

date_formula.description: DateFormula: a types.Code field that holds a date formula ("30D", "1M+CM"); the field checks and ValidateField reject a value that is not one (foundation/dateformula), and business logic calculates with it: system.CalcDate(string(rec.Due_date_calculation), d)

decimal_places.description: DecimalPlaces (classic DecimalPlaces "min:max"): the pages show a decimal with at least min and at most max digits after the point ("2:5" → 0.01, 0.00001); storage keeps scale

description.description: What the field holds, for people reading the file.

editable.description: Editable: false (classic Editable=No) — the pages show the field read-only and the API keeps its stored value; business logic (Go) can still set it

encrypted.description: Encrypted: a masked secret the server has to read back in clear (e.g. the SMTP password it logs in with) is stored encrypted (backend/foundation/secrets, AES-256-GCM) — Insert/Modify/InsertAll encrypt it, Plain<Field>() decrypts it. Requires masked and types.Text. Not for values that are only compared (user passwords: hash them, sensitive).

flow_filter.description: FlowFilter (FieldClass FlowFilter): not stored; holds a filter expression the user sets (e.g. Date Filter), applied by FlowFields with a flow filter of type "filter"

masked.description: Masked (ExtendedDatatype Masked): a secret that can be set through the API but is never read back — responses carry tables.MaskedValue when it has a value (e.g. SMTP_Setup.password); not usable in filters, sorting, search or lookup columns

no.description: Field number (field ID): unique in the table, never changed or reused

reverse_sign.description: ReverseSign (Sum FlowFields): the total with the opposite sign (classic CalcFormula=-Sum, e.g. Customer Payments)

sensitive.description: Sensitive: never sent by the table API (e.g. User.password_hash), and not usable in filters, sorting, search or lookup columns; the API cannot set it either

TableFlowFilter.description: FlowFilter represents a filter condition for FlowField calculation

type.description: "const", "field", "filter" (apply a FlowFilter field of this table), "field_filter" (a stored field of this table holding a filter, e.g. Totaling) or "language" (the current user's language, i18n.SessionLanguage — Object Caption)

upper_limit.description: UpperLimit (type "filter"): only the upper end of the FlowFilter applies — up to the filter's last date, from the start ("Balance at Date": Posting Date = UpperLimit(Date Filter))

value.description: A constant value, or the field / FlowFilter field of this table the filter takes its value from.

TableLookupColumn.description: LookupColumn defines a column to display in the lookup dropdown

search.description: Search (optional): the stored field the dropdown's search looks in for this column — a FlowField is shown, not searched (Object's Caption searches its Name)

TableRelationCondition.description: RelationCondition is one branch of a conditional table relation

conditions.description: Conditions (classic IF (Type=CONST(x)) Table ELSE IF …): the relation depends on another field of the record — each condition is a relation of its own (Table, Field, lookup columns) that applies when the record's field equals the value; Table/Field stay blank

display_field.description: Field to show in dropdown (e.g., "description") - simple mode

filters.description: Filters (classic TableRelation … WHERE (Field=FIELD(x)) / CONST(y)): the related records are those whose column matches this record's field (field) or a constant (const) — for a key part of a composite key (Reminder Level No. of the record's Reminder Terms)

lookup_columns.description: Columns to show in dropdown - advanced mode

validate.description: Whether to validate the relation (default: true)

field.description: an option field of the same table (e.g. bal_account_type)

TableRelationFilter.description: RelationFilter is one WHERE condition of a table relation: a field of this record or a constant

TableTableRelation.description: TableRelation represents a foreign key relationship to another table

conditions.description: Conditions (classic IF (Type=CONST(x)) Table ELSE IF …): the relation depends on another field of the record — each condition is a relation of its own (Table, Field, lookup columns) that applies when the record's field equals the value; Table/Field stay blank

display_field.description: Field to show in dropdown (e.g., "description") - simple mode

filters.description: Filters (classic TableRelation … WHERE (Field=FIELD(x)) / CONST(y)): the related records are those whose column matches this record's field (field) or a constant (const) — for a key part of a composite key (Reminder Level No. of the record's Reminder Terms)

lookup_columns.description: Columns to show in dropdown - advanced mode

validate.description: Whether to validate the relation (default: true)

TableValidation.description: Validation represents field validation rules Validation is a field's range (classic MinValue / MaxValue): min, max or both; on whole numbers and decimals

description: Fields an app adds to a table of the base or of another app (tables/<id>-<name>.extend.yaml; EXTENSIONS.md, section 4).

extends_table.description: The number of the table the fields are added to.

fields.description: The fields, written as a table definition's fields, numbered in the app's field series and named with its prefix.
